sources.note: Main website. Describes Edvak as all-in-one AI-powered EHR with 5 modules: EHR, practice management, patient engagement, RCM, and analytics. Targets solo to large ambulatory networks.
ONC certification page. Lists Edvak EHR v1 certified June 13, 2025 with 39 criteria. Notes integrations with EMR Direct, Medi-Span, Exostar, Surescripts. MFA via Authy.
EHR feature page. Describes AI-scribed documentation, speech-to-text, lab/imaging integration, clinical decision support, patient engagement tools, and RCM features.
Advanced EHR page. Details AI documentation, lab/imaging management, prescribing with drug formulary access, analytics, and workflow management.
Lab and imaging feature page. Describes electronic ordering, direct result integration into patient records, real-time tracking dashboard, and AI-driven analytics.
Billing/RCM page. Describes insurance eligibility checks, automated ICD/CPT code capture, claims management, denial predictions, and patient payments. Integrated into the EHR platform.
Pricing page. Four tiers: Essential ($299), Plus ($549), Premium ($599), Enterprise (custom). EHR-only and EHR+billing options. Feature breakdown by tier.

EHI export page. Exports in C-CDA format. Single patient and population export. Includes demographics, medications, problems, allergies, vitals, immunizations, lab results, procedures, care plans, clinical notes.
Blog post. Confirms Edvak is exclusively cloud-based. References 'hundreds of small practices across the US' using the platform. Targets small to mid-sized practices.
Capterra listing. Categorized in Family Practice EMR, Revenue Management, Medical Practice Management, EMR, and RCM. Mentions charting and coding assistance features. No detailed user reviews found.
Crunchbase profile. Page returned 403 — no detailed data accessible. Founded 2018 per other sources.
